description:
Our sustainability journey has been shaped by people around the world, working step by step to make meaningful progress. As we look toward 2030, we are deepening our commitment by setting three new goals that guide how we design, operate, and grow. Learn more about our 2030 commitments: http://smsng.co/Galaxy-Planet_yt 

00:00 Intro
00:04 Our sustainability journey 
00:17 Galaxy for the Planet 2025
00:59 Our 2030 goals
01:16 Galaxy for the Planet 2030 

By 2030, Samsung is committed to:
Circularity: Incorporating at least one recycled material into every module of every Galaxy mobile phone, tablet, laptop, and watch.
Water Stewardship: Achieving the highest level of water resource management and returning 110 % of water consumption.
Biodiversity: Conserving ecosystems equivalent in area to Samsung’s global mobile operations.
This is our journey. The human side of tech, built with purpose.
 
#Samsung

Unleash your creativity in just a few taps with Creative Studio:
Step 1: Launch Creative Studio. Swipe the Edge panel or swipe up from the home screen to find Creative Studio. Tap it to open.
Step 2: Craft stickers. In Design studio, tap the ‘Gallery’ icon. Choose an image and the style for the sticker. Tap the ‘Generate’ icon to turn your image into a unique sticker. You can also add a background by tapping the prompt bar and typing in a short sentence.
